checks: After selecting a tree type, A on the focused type chip opens a child draft; saving preserves the method and hidden notes. Counts read 1 thought and 2 thoughts.
Enter and Space on + still open its choices, Escape restores control focus, and arrow keys do not become card-navigation commands.
Shift+A adds a sibling draft, E edits the owning thought and T opens its tree type from a focused card control, without implicit saves.
Typing shortcut letters and Enter inside the editor stays ordinary text; using another card control while a draft exists cannot replace or save it.
The same letter shortcuts work from the collapse control.
